title: Casterwill Library
summary: The Casterwill Library is located in the suburbs of Montmorency, Paris, France nearby the old Paris Casterwill house where Sophie Casterwill grew up. The library later served as the base of operations for Lucas Casterwill's team.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The place had been first discovered by Sophie and Cherit, when Dante sent them to look for a Foundation Library while he and Lok went to Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot. As they entered they had been observed by Lane and Dellix. Inside they found the key to a Casterwill cypher. [Memory Lane]

Later the whole team returned there to look for information about Willblade. It was then when they first encountered Lucas and his teammates. The two teams fought before coming to an understanding. [Chasing Void]

Sophie, Lok and Cherit returned to the library to update Lucas and his team on the emergence of the Blood Spiral after their failed mission to recover Void from Klaus' bookshop. [The Blood Spiral]

Lucas, Lane and Dellix were residing here when Lok Lambert summoned Quetzalcoatl, and activated the Blue Star. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

The library was also one of Sophie's recurring childhood memories. [Memory Lane] [Chasing Void] [The Phoenix's Ashes]

==History==
The place had been first discovered by Sophie and Cherit, when Dante sent them to look for a Foundation Library while he and Lok went to Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot. As they entered they had been observed by Lane and Dellix. Inside they found the key to a Casterwill cypher. [Memory Lane]

Later the whole team returned there to look for information about Willblade. It was then when they first encountered Lucas and his teammates. The two teams fought before coming to an understanding. [Chasing Void]

Sophie, Lok and Cherit returned to the library to update Lucas and his team on the emergence of the Blood Spiral after their failed mission to recover Void from Klaus' bookshop. [The Blood Spiral]

Lucas, Lane and Dellix were residing here when Lok Lambert summoned Quetzalcoatl, and activated the Blue Star. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

The library was also one of Sophie's recurring childhood memories. [Memory Lane] [Chasing Void] [The Phoenix's Ashes]
